notes: Ruka 0.3.97: parallel-editor hardening. Adds declaration-level structural merging, a model conflict-resolver agent, one automatic editor retry when a merge gate fails, a live per-editor dashboard, and a real-model benchmark mode. The deterministic benchmark still measures orchestration; model mode measures the active model on three real edit tasks. Verified structural merge, resolver fallback, retry after gate failure, progress events and a qwen2.5:3b baseline of 1/3 tasks. Adds a GitHub Pages update mirror so new builds can see the latest manifest when the custom update server is stale.
